html:
SMTO-UI-0035 — This box needs a list in square brackets

GUID: 0994e6fb-accb-4545-92ae-c22cb83a6a8f
Slug: ui-json-array-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • This box expects a list of items inside square brackets. What you typed was valid but wasn't a list, so the parameter wasn't saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On the Context tab, open Advanced semantic context and find the box with the error (Concepts, Metrics or Relationships). Wrap its items in square brackets, for example ["revenue", "churn"]. Square brackets tell SMTO the value is a list.
  2. Put each text item in double quotes and separate items with commas. If you have nothing to add, type [] on its own. These boxes are optional, and an empty pair of square brackets means an empty list.
  3. Select Save at the top of the parameter. The parameter is only saved once every box on its tabs is in the right form.

What success looks like

  • The parameter shows "Saved" and the error under the box is gone.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Keep passwords and keys out of the Context boxes; they are not hidden.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Parameter Store context field that must be a JSON array (Concepts, Metrics or Relationships) parsed to a different JSON type, so the parameter was not saved.

What this means

  • A parameter field designated as an array parses to a different JSON type. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A parameter field designated as an array parses to a different JSON type.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the parsed top-level value rather than its displayed text alone.

How to fix it

  • parameter_editor.js parseJson(field, label, true) throws ui_json_array_required when a Context-tab array field (concepts, metrics, relationships in user_provided_domain_context) parses to a non-array. Enter a JSON array, for example [] or ["revenue", "churn"].
  • Enter a JSON array in the marked field.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The field contains a supported JSON array.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
